Race zones

All distances are in meters. Values are clamped to safe ranges. Lap outer must stay at least 20 m beyond lap inner so GPS jitter does not double-count crossings.
Start zone radius
Sprint: how close you must be to the green start pin to trigger. Shown as the green circle when placing pins.
Finish zone radius
Sprint: how close you must be to the red finish pin to end the run.
Lap line — inner radius
Lap mode: distance at which you are considered on the line (inside).
Lap line — outer radius
Lap mode: you must move farther than this to be off the line before the next crossing can count.
